question: Should the experimental Claws stack standardize on `CLAW.md` as its canonical exported package artifact while continuing to accept grouped JSON manifests?
rationale: This is a new user-facing package-format and export convention, not a repair to an established shipped contract; the right long-term format and rollout boundary require maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Adopt CLAW.md for the experimental stack
options.body: Approve CLAW.md as the canonical export form once the complete stack lands with current-head lifecycle proof and JSON compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical for now
options.body: Retain grouped JSON as the exported form and defer Markdown authoring until the experimental lifecycle has further maintainer validation.

options.title: Pause the format slice
options.body: Defer this PR until the parent lifecycle work is merged or narrowed into a maintainer-approved package-format proposal.

recommendation.title: Adopt CLAW.md for the experimental stack
recommendation.body: Approve CLAW.md as the canonical export form once the complete stack lands with current-head lifecycle proof and JSON compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the author of the staged Claws format and lifecycle design; a repository owner should make the final product decision.
